# A heading is never joined
with the paragraph after it

This paragraph is
spread over
several   lines, with `code spans`,
[links](https://example.com/a/long/path "and titles")
and <span>inline HTML</span>.

A hard break\
ends a line, and the lines
after it are joined
again.

> A quote
> - with a list item
>   that continues
>
> and a last paragraph
> in two lines.

| Tables | stay |
| ------ | ---- |
| as     | they |
| are    | were |
